messages:
Maya: Heads up — CI SAST on main started failing after the RBAC change to the scanner role. Error looks like KMS decrypt failures when uploading scan evidence. Anyone seen this?
Jon: @Maya saw a few alerts. Looks like the scanner service account gets a 403 from KMS: 'Request denied: kms.cryptoKeys.decrypt'.
SecBot: scan-alert: SAST job #4217 failed — unable to decrypt artifact key (kms:AccessDenied). Link: https://ci.internal/scans/4217 (auto-report)
Luis: can you paste the smallest log snippet so infra can triage quickly?
Maya: sure — here's the minimal error we get from the scanner agent:
```
2026-03-21T15:12:03Z ERROR artifact-uploader: decrypt failed: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc="projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/scan-keys/cryptoKeys/artifact-key: request denied"
error detail: iam reason=missingPermission serviceAccount=svc-scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Jon: that matches my suspicion — the RBAC change removed iam.cryptoKeyDecrypter binding on the key for the scanner SA. We reverted the user-facing RBAC, but scanner SA binding wasn't included in the rollback.
Tara: short-term fix: grant the decrypter role back to svc-scanner for the artifact key (least privilege). Long-term: add a premerge check to validate scanner SA has decrypt perms before RBAC changes land.
Jon: quick command we used in a similar incident: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding artifact-key \
  --keyring=scan-keys --location=global \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Luis: will adding that grant preserve audibility? We need a clear audit trail for the change and the decrypt attempts.
Tara: yes — KMS and Cloud Audit Logs will show the binding addition and subsequent decrypt calls. We should capture the IAM change PR and link it in the incident doc.
Maya: also: can we make SAST fallback more graceful? Right now the pipeline hard-fails on KMS decrypt. Maybe fall back to a scrubbed upload that omits secrets and marks the artifact as 'partial' to unblock triage.
Jon: agree. I'll prototype a fallback where if decrypt fails we still push a redacted artifact to an alternate bucket (with separate policy) and tag the scan status as 'degraded'.
Luis: also flag: add a unit test in CI that simulates KMS permission denied so we catch this in premerge. Simple e2e run that revokes a test SA then asserts scan job fails with expected error code.
Tara: I'll add the checklist item to the RBAC change playbook: "validate scanner SA decrypt access" + include the rollback snippet.
Maya: who will own follow-up doc? I'll create a short postmortem-ish note and link infra PRs. @Jon can you open the PR for the role add + the fallback prototype?
Jon: will do, opening PR and pinging infra and sec for review. ETA: today EOD. :thumbsup:
Luis: thanks — I'll coordinate audit evidence collection and attach logs to the doc.
Maya: OK marking this triage done for now. Filed follow-ups: PR for grant, PR for fallback, test in CI, playbook update. Doc link: https://docs.internal/security/incidents/1755557777-scan-perm-check
